platform: Cloud SaaS, browser-based MIS with native iOS and Android parent/guardian and student apps; no on-premise MIS deployment documented.

distinctive_features.feature: Ask Arbor and Smart Reports, including an Ofsted Inspection Companion
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Natural-language answers and editable inspection materials can reduce report preparation and data-navigation effort.

distinctive_features.feature: Auto Absence voicemail transcription and translation
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: It converts absence voicemails into staff-reviewable records, including support for families who use other languages.
Trust teams can distribute assessment, pay-scale, permission and user-field policies while allowing local school autonomy.
Schools can compare operational and attainment data against DfE, Ofsted and Arbor national benchmarks.
Forms, approvals, reminders, conditional logic and audit trails can automate administrative processes without custom software.
Schools can manage charges for trips, meals, clubs and shops alongside parent communications and student records.
Census dry runs, error resolution and submission files support school and workforce statutory reporting.

distinctive_features.feature: Partner API approval and revocation controls
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools can review and manage partner access to data rather than granting integrations unexamined access.

weaknesses.issue: Parent app reviews report confusing navigation, login failures, slow loading and random logouts.
Student app reviews report poor usability, login or loading problems, and difficulties submitting homework.
Trustpilot reviews describe confusing design, slow performance, errors and support friction; reviews are unverified.
Cloud access depends on reliable internet, Wi-Fi, browser and device configuration.
Payroll, full accounting, transport, library, boarding, alumni and fundraising require separate products or integrations.
Full master scheduling relies on separate TimeTabler or third-party tools rather than the core MIS.
Reviewed materials do not establish OneRoster, LTI, Ed-Fi or SIF certification.
Current pricing is quote-based, and published G-Cloud prices are historical rather than current quotes.
Partner integrations require school approval, and schools cannot independently customise every permission set.

ai_features: Smart Reports and Ofsted Inspection Companion
Email, letter and SMS drafting and translation
Auto Absence voicemail transcription, translation and logging
pricing_model_summary: Quote-based; historical 2024/25 G-Cloud pricing used annual per-student charges plus school base fees, with separate MAT, setup, training and optional service charges.
biggest_strategic_gap: The UK-focused MIS depends on integrations or separate products for several operational areas, while mobile app complaints and internet dependence may weaken everyday user experience.
